brains.name: Trade Integrity
brains.purpose: Validates P/L, direction and replay before learning.

brains.name: Failure School
brains.purpose: Studies losses, givebacks and poor management.

brains.name: Profit Capture
brains.purpose: Measures MFE capture and profit giveback.

brains.name: Time Intelligence
brains.purpose: Measures how trade outcomes change through time.

brains.name: Management Challenger
brains.purpose: Tests alternative exit policies in shadow replay.

brains.name: Committee Memory
brains.purpose: Tracks specialist evidence over repeated outcomes.

brains.name: Trade Reflection
brains.purpose: Grades process, finds first failure clues and studies whether the opposite direction was superior.

brains.name: Missed Clue Miner
brains.purpose: Finds repeated clues the engine may have overlooked before failed trades.

brains.name: Experience Store
brains.purpose: Separates validated experience into train, validation and locked holdout datasets.

brains.name: Reward Engine
brains.purpose: Scores process dimensions separately instead of treating profit/loss as the only reward.

brains.name: Adversarial Learning
brains.purpose: Actively searches for counterexamples that can disprove candidate lessons.

brains.name: Learning Curriculum
brains.purpose: Locks advanced learning until foundational competencies pass measurable gates.

brains.name: Learning Governor
brains.purpose: Controls lesson maturity; V21 does not automatically promote any lesson into live trading rules.
